notes: Background: mid-market post-purchase support platform for merchants (returns + shipping queries). Heavy seasonality (peak windows around BF/Cyber).
Primary ask: lower latency for interactive chat agents + reliable tool-calls (order lookup, RMA issuance) during bursts.
Initial interest: Hosted API for fast iteration (demo done 2026-02-14). Team likes streaming + function/tool calling for synchronous order lookups.
Quoted target: p95 end-to-end interactive response <= 500ms for simple lookups; p95 for streaming start-of-response < 300ms. P99 acceptable degradation path defined.
POC scope agreed (verbal): 2-week synthetic traffic run modeling 3x baseline peak; integrate order-lookup tool call; validate streaming latency and KV cache hit-rate.

Architecture notes from SE (Marcus): recommend prefix/KV caching for recent order queries, client-side incremental streaming, and a small Dedicated pool if variability during peak cannot meet SLOs on Hosted.

Security: Legal asked for SOC2 report + KMS key handling. Also asked whether Private/VPC option available for enterprise-only merchants. They want retention controls for transcripts (30/90 day options).
Pricing convo: finance is cost-sensitive to peak. Looking for committed burst buffer pricing vs pure on-demand. Requesting a delta sheet between Hosted vs Dedicated (monthly commit tiers).
Timeline: Demo 2026-02-14; security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-18; POC kickoff target 2026-03-01 pending security ok and test data scrubbed.
Quotes & feedback: Product lead said, "Fast start of response on streaming felt noticeably better than our current provider — need consistent p95 across bursts."
Operational ask: tracing hooks per-request (route/model), token-level cost breakdown for each flow, and automatic fallback to a smaller cheaper model when latency > threshold.
POC success criteria (agreed): p95 streaming start <= 350ms under 3x synthetic load; tool-call latency p95 <= 250ms; no more than 5% error rate on lookup calls.
Next internal steps: send POC runbook, provide test-key and sample harness, confirm JIRA ticket for any infra escalations (INF-4127 assigned).
Blockers captured: Legal on residency SLA, Finance needs cost estimate for 3-tier commit, Engineering wants cert of client library stability for streaming SDKs.
